CHAPTER.VERS: But you, speak the things which are suitable to Moshiach's orthodox Jewish doctrine.
Zekenim need to be temperate, respectable, men of seychel, being orthodox [in Moshiach] in the emunah, in ahavah, in savlanut

Similarly the senior women, the zekanot, in hitnahagut
conduct as befits kedushah, not yentas of slander nor slaves of wine, but melamedot es haTov
teachers of the Good
that they may encourage the young nashim to have ahavah for their ba'alim and their banim,
to have seychel, tahor in tznius, domestic workers baBayit, tov lev, being submissive to their ba'alim, lest chillul Hashem come to the dvar haElohim.
The bochrim, similarly, exhort to have seychel
about all things, showing yourself a mofet of ma'asim tovim. In the hora'ah [of Moshiach], show integrity, seriousness,

along with dibur
speech that is orthodox [in Moshiach] and beyond reproach, that the mitnagged may be ashamed, having no lashon hora to say against you.

Avadim
slaves need to be submissive to their own adonim in everything, to be acceptable, not talking back,
not pilfering, but showing all good reliability, that they may adorn the hora'ah of Hashem Moshieynu in all things.
For the Chen v'chesed of Hashem has appeared, bringing Yeshu'at Eloheynu to kol bnei Adam,
instructing us to deny all that is frai and not chassidus [in Moshiach] and all that is ta'avanut, and to live with seychel and tzedek Hashem and yirat Shamayim in Olam Hazeh,
awaiting the tikvah hameashsheret, the appearing of the kavod haEloheinu haGadol and Moshieynu Yehoshua the Moshiach,

who gave his nefesh on behalf of us, that he might bring in the Geulah for us, redeeming us MI KOL AVONOTAV
TEHILLIM 130:8 , making tahor AM LI SEGULAH
"A PEOPLE FOR MY POSSESSION" --SHEMOT 19:5 , zealous for ma'asim tovim.
Preach these things, give chizak and reprove with all authority. Let no one "write you off."
